name: Grappling Hook
description: Fire a hook and get pulled straight to it. Click to fire, click again to let go. Hang there as long as you like and switch items while you do; hold jump to reel in and crouch to let rope out, or roll the mouse wheel. It bites bricks and the map, and players and vehicles too unless an admin turns that off with /hookobjects. Type /grapplinghook for one. Based on the Grappling Hook by Conan.
